stories.title: Add APPEND, STRLEN, SETEX, INCRBY, DECRBY string commands
stories.description:
Add 5 basic string commands to the RedisCommands typeclass, RedisCommandClient instance, and ClusterCommandClient instance.

In hask-redis-mux/lib/redis-command-client/Database/Redis/Command.hs:
1. Add to typeclass (between line 123 incr and line 124 hset):
   append :: (FromResp a) => ByteString -> ByteString -> m a
   strlen :: (FromResp a) => ByteString -> m a
   setex :: (FromResp a) => ByteString -> Int -> ByteString -> m a
   incrby :: (FromResp a) => ByteString -> Int -> m a
   decrby :: (FromResp a) => ByteString -> Int -> m a

2. Add to RedisCommandClient instance (after decr, around line 325):
   append key value = executeCommandAs ["APPEND", key, value]
   strlen key = executeCommandAs ["STRLEN", key]
   setex key seconds value = executeCommandAs ["SETEX", key, showBS seconds, value]
   incrby key amount = executeCommandAs ["INCRBY", key, showBS amount]
   decrby key amount = executeCommandAs ["DECRBY", key, showBS amount]

3. Add to ClusterCommandClient instance in hask-redis-mux/lib/cluster/Database/Redis/Cluster/Client.hs (after decr around line 558):
   append k v = executeKeyedAs k ["APPEND", k, v]
   strlen k = executeKeyedAs k ["STRLEN", k]
   setex k secs v = executeKeyedAs k ["SETEX", k, showBS secs, v]
   incrby k amt = executeKeyedAs k ["INCRBY", k, showBS amt]
   decrby k amt = executeKeyedAs k ["DECRBY", k, showBS amt]

Build with: nix-shell --run 'cabal build all'

   getdel :: (FromResp a) => ByteString -> m a

3. Add to ClusterCommandClient instance:

   getdel k = executeKeyedAs k ["GETDEL", k]
   getex k opts = executeKeyedAs k (["GETEX", k] ++ opts)

stories.title: Add LINSERT, LSET, LTRIM, LREM list commands
stories.description:
Add 4 list commands.

In hask-redis-mux/lib/redis-command-client/Database/Redis/Command.hs:
1. Add to typeclass (after lindex line):
   linsert :: (FromResp a) => ByteString -> ByteString -> ByteString -> ByteString -> m a
   -- linsert key position(BEFORE/AFTER) pivot element
   lset :: (FromResp a) => ByteString -> Int -> ByteString -> m a
   ltrim :: (FromResp a) => ByteString -> Int -> Int -> m a
   lrem :: (FromResp a) => ByteString -> Int -> ByteString -> m a

2. Add to RedisCommandClient instance (after lindex):
   linsert key pos pivot element = executeCommandAs ["LINSERT", key, pos, pivot, element]
   lset key index element = executeCommandAs ["LSET", key, showBS index, element]
   ltrim key start stop = executeCommandAs ["LTRIM", key, showBS start, showBS stop]
   lrem key count element = executeCommandAs ["LREM", key, showBS count, element]

3. Add to ClusterCommandClient instance (after lindex):
   linsert k pos pivot element = executeKeyedAs k ["LINSERT", k, pos, pivot, element]
   lset k idx element = executeKeyedAs k ["LSET", k, showBS idx, element]
   ltrim k start stop = executeKeyedAs k ["LTRIM", k, showBS start, showBS stop]
   lrem k cnt element = executeKeyedAs k ["LREM", k, showBS cnt, element]

Note: linsert uses ByteString for the position arg ("BEFORE" or "AFTER") to match the existing pattern of letting callers pass Redis keywords directly.

Build with: nix-shell --run 'cabal build all'

stories.title: Add SREM, SDIFF, SINTER, SUNION, SPOP, SRANDMEMBER set commands
stories.description:
Add 6 set commands.

In hask-redis-mux/lib/redis-command-client/Database/Redis/Command.hs:
1. Add to typeclass (after sismember line):
   srem :: (FromResp a) => ByteString -> [ByteString] -> m a
   sdiff :: (FromResp a) => [ByteString] -> m a
   sinter :: (FromResp a) => [ByteString] -> m a
   sunion :: (FromResp a) => [ByteString] -> m a
   spop :: (FromResp a) => ByteString -> m a
   srandmember :: (FromResp a) => ByteString -> m a

2. Add to RedisCommandClient instance (after sismember):
   srem key members = executeCommandAs ("SREM" : key : members)
   sdiff keys = executeCommandAs ("SDIFF" : keys)
   sinter keys = executeCommandAs ("SINTER" : keys)
   sunion keys = executeCommandAs ("SUNION" : keys)
   spop key = executeCommandAs ["SPOP", key]
   srandmember key = executeCommandAs ["SRANDMEMBER", key]

3. Add to ClusterCommandClient instance (after sismember):
   srem k members = executeKeyedAs k ("SREM" : k : members)
   sdiff keys = case keys of
     []    -> executeKeyless (RedisCommandClient.sdiff [])
     (k:_) -> executeKeyedAs k ("SDIFF" : keys)
   sinter keys = case keys of
     []    -> executeKeyless (RedisCommandClient.sinter [])
     (k:_) -> executeKeyedAs k ("SINTER" : keys)
   sunion keys = case keys of
     []    -> executeKeyless (RedisCommandClient.sunion [])
     (k:_) -> executeKeyedAs k ("SUNION" : keys)
   spop k = executeKeyedAs k ["SPOP", k]
   srandmember k = executeKeyedAs k ["SRANDMEMBER", k]

   zincrby k increment member = executeKeyedAs k ["ZINCRBY", k, showBS increment, member]
   zrangestore dst src minVal maxVal opts = executeKeyedAs dst (["ZRANGESTORE", dst, src, minVal, maxVal] ++ opts)

stories.title: Update module exports and re-export module for new commands
stories.description:
Ensure all newly added commands are properly exported. Also update the CHANGELOG.md in hask-redis-mux/ to document the new commands.

The RedisCommands typeclass is already exported from Command.hs module, so its new methods are automatically visible. But verify:

1. Check that hask-redis-mux/lib/redis/Database/Redis.hs re-exports everything needed. It should already re-export RedisCommands(..) which includes all methods.

2. Update hask-redis-mux/CHANGELOG.md to add an entry documenting all 39 new commands added:
   - String: append, strlen, setex, incrby, decrby, incrbyfloat, getdel, getex
   - Hash: hgetall, hlen, hsetnx, hincrby, hincrbyfloat
   - List: linsert, lset, ltrim, lrem
   - Set: srem, sdiff, sinter, sunion, spop, srandmember
   - Sorted Set: zrem, zcard, zscore, zrank, zrevrank, zcount, zincrby, zrangestore
   - Key: persist, keyType, rename, renamenx, unlink
   - HyperLogLog: pfadd, pfcount, pfmerge

3. Run the build one final time and ensure all tests pass:
   nix-shell --run 'cabal build all && cabal test all'

Build with: nix-shell --run 'cabal build all && cabal test all'
